reason: We have always washed by hand at the tap and it gets done; spending twenty-two thousand on a machine for something that already works is hard to justify. Even ₹1,999 a month for a year is a big commitment for something the house has never needed.
objection: Will a cold wash in a semi-automatic really get the mud and sweat out of farm clothes? If the women still have to scrub them by hand afterwards, I have paid for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it wash a neighbour's muddy farm clothes properly, in front of me, through a power cut, at a price closer to fifteen thousand.
